name: select
description: A source-owned compositional select with keyboard navigation and typeahead.

documentation.compositionNote: The copied façade re-exports the owned Select parts; applications can style each primitive part directly with Dioxus class attributes while the runtime retains keyboard, typeahead, and ARIA behavior.
documentation.accessibility: Implements the WAI-ARIA APG Listbox pattern: `SelectTrigger` is the APG's combobox-like button and `SelectList` is `role="listbox"`, anchored to the trigger via `Positioner` (`packages/adico-primitives/src/select.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: Full keyboard support: arrow keys navigate options, Home/End jump to the ends, Enter selects, Escape closes; typeahead lets typing jump to a matching option.
